reviews.title: Powerful, Stylish, and Smart
reviews.comment: The MPG CORELIQUID P13 360 pairs strong cooling performance from its 360mm radiator and triple 120mm PWM fans with an eye-catching IPS 2.1" LCD for customization. The Uni Bracket makes installation tidy and straightforward, and the white finish plus ARGB lighting gives a clean, premium look. Quiet under load and excellent for high-end builds—great pick if you want performance with flair.
reviews.author: SakuP
